Definition: to suck; causatively, to give milk
BiblicalUsage: Yânaq is the word for giving suck, for a mother nursing her child. The woman before Solomon rose to give her child suck and found him dead, and Hannah gave Samuel suck until she weaned him and brought him to the house of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a mother's care is the first picture of God's provision, and Hannah's nursing was already an offering.
